label: Whatever has power for the actual contingent concreta's joint absence gives each of them being at w
paraphrase: OPEN (the creator/conserver reading of the holder; analyst formulation, attribution deferred): whatever has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w gives being, in w (GivesTo: at some moment of w), to every concrete being contingent at w. Not sole giving, not immediacy, not freedom. Motivation, navigation only: ST I q.104 a.3 co., God preserves things 'by continually pouring out existence into them'.
